summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md and the UI guidelines, and asked non-visual scope questions in the terminal. It got through two auto-compactions between loading the skill and the layout question. When the layout question came up, it opened the visual companion on its own: it ran scripts/start-server.sh, gave a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html with three layouts (A filter bar, B compact row plus popover, C sidebar). I hadn't given any visual cue. After I picked A, it cleared the screen to a waiting page, went back to the terminal, proposed the design in chat, and asked for approval. Once I approved, it said it was re-reading the guidelines "before touching code". Then Claude Code stopped with "Autocompact is thrashing" before any implementation file was edited. No spec file and no plan was created.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is supported by the log and by files on disk. The companion opened just-in-time on the layout question without any visual cue from me. Non-visual questions stayed in the terminal. The design stayed in chat with no spec or plan, approval was asked before any code, and the agent said it was starting implementation. The one serious issue is that Claude Code halted on autocompact thrashing before any code was written. I've reported that as a bug. It doesn't break the scenario's stated criteria, since criterion 8 accepts a stated intent to begin.

observations.description: After I approved, the session stopped on Claude Code's own error: "Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row." The log has 5 compact_boundary events (21:22:48, 21:23:26, 21:29:18, 21:30:21, 21:31:33). After each compaction the agent re-reads the long UI guideline docs, which refills the context. It never wrote any implementation code. The scenario's 'stated it would begin' bar is met, but in practice the task can't move forward without the user stepping in (e.g. /clear).

Two compactions happened before the agent's first question to me, about a minute into the session. Reading four long guideline documents in full uses up most of the context window. 'Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)' is printed again and again on screen.

The agent warned that 'The browser tab uses a lot of tokens', which is a useful heads-up. It also noted that .hyperpowers/ should be added to .gitignore because the repo has none. The .hyperpowers/ folder is left untracked in the worktree.

Claude Code onboarding: the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs default to 'No, exit'. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt saying Opus 5 was pinned even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5.
In the design summary, the agent said it would leave alone the existing problem that the table doesn't render without JS. Good scope discipline.

criteria.evidence: The first tool call in the session log was Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}, and the screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh, localhost URL, HTML screen of layouts
criteria.evidence: The log has a Bash call running `scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir ...`, then a Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/74393-1793827483/content/filter-placement.html. That file contains the headings 'Filter bar above the table (always visible)', 'Shortcuts and dates inline, event types behind a "More filters" button' and 'Sidebar to the left of the table'. The screen said: "I've drawn three placement options in a browser tab ... http://localhost:51920/?key=4c2acb6e...".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: Skill, then reads, then AskUserQuestion 'What should people be able to narrow ... by?' in the terminal, then start-server.sh, then the HTML write. The later questions ('Security changes' types, token sheet) were also asked with AskUserQuestion in the terminal. After my pick it wrote waiting.html with 'Continuing in terminal...'.

The agent said: "Since the page already exists, I'll outline a short design here in chat rather than a full spec". The full design (Files/Testing/Commits) was posted in chat and ended with "Is this good to go?".

`ls docs/superpowers docs/hyperpowers` returned 'No such file or directory' for both. `find` for *specs* and *plan* returned nothing. The only Write calls in the log were filter-placement.html and waiting.html.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill call in the log was hyperpowers:brainstorming. No plan file exists (find returned nothing). `git status` shows only `?? .hyperpowers/`.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of chosen layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: It asked me to "Have a look and tell me what you think here" before my pick. After the pick it presented the design and asked "Is this good to go?". The log has no Edit or Write to public/* files before that.

criteria.criterion: After pick, began implementation or stated it would
criteria.evidence: After my approval the screen showed: "re-reading ... the four UI guideline files in full before touching code" and "I'm about to change UI". No implementation edit actually landed before the Autocompact-thrashing halt (git status shows only .hyperpowers/).
